user.title: Connect to GoXLR Utility
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of the PC running the GoXLR Utility. In the Utility, network access must be enabled so it listens on more than localhost.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the GoXLR Utility. Check the address, that the Utility is running, and that network access is enabled.

abort.already_configured: This GoXLR Utility is already configured

send_command.name: Send GoXLR command
send_command.description: Sends any raw command to a GoXLR, for features without a dedicated entity. Command names and arguments follow the GoXLR Utility API, e.g. {"SetScribbleText": ["A", "ON AIR"]}.

device_id.name: GoXLR
device_id.description: The GoXLR (mixer) device to send the command to.

send_utility_command.name: Send GoXLR Utility command
send_utility_command.description: Sends any raw command to the GoXLR Utility app itself (app-level settings), e.g. {"SetSampleGainPct": ["intro.wav", 80]}.

config_entry_id.name: GoXLR Utility
config_entry_id.description: Which Utility to use. Optional when only one is set up.

init.title: Advanced controls
init.description: Choose which groups of advanced controls to show. Turning a group on enables all of its entities, and turning it off hides them again. Groups you don't change keep any entities you enabled or disabled yourself.

data_description.routing: One switch per input → output route (~45).
data_description.mix_b: Per-channel Mix B volumes and links, and which mix each output uses. Only work while the 'Mix B (submix)' switch is on.
data_description.eq: Gain and frequency for every EQ band.
data_description.mic_timing: Attack and release for the noise gate and compressor.
data_description.effects_fine: Reverb decay, echo delays and tempo, robot bands and the other deep effect parameters. The main amount and style controls are always on.
data_description.screens: Number, icon and invert for the fader screens. The screen text is always on.
data_description.sampler_pads: Playback mode and order for every pad in every bank, the pre-record buffer and the clear behaviour.
data_description.lighting: Animation modifiers, waterfall direction and per-fader light styles.
data_description.other: Mic level sensor (changes every second while you talk), VOD mode, effect preset rename, Utility log level, open window on launch.
